assay: bulk short-read RNA-seq, vastus lateralis biopsies (Rubenstein et al. deposit); the paper re-quantified paired-end FASTQs with RSEM-STAR on GENCODE 42 (S2.5.p1)
sample_inclusion: older adults 65-90 y, two cohorts: active/endurance-trained (hsAA, 10: 8M 2F) and sedentary (hsAS, 9: 7M 2F) (S2.1.p1)
single 40-min cycling bout; biopsies pre and 3 h post exercise (S2.1.p1)
only males at pre and 3 h post with paired-end FASTQ were analysed (S2.1.p1, FIG1)
sample_exclusion: the immediate-post-exercise time point deposited in GEO ('Post')
primary_estimand: Acute-exercise effect on vastus lateralis gene expression (3 h post vs pre), estimated separately within the sedentary (hsAS) and the active (hsAA) older cohort (S3.1.p1, FIG2B,D).

blocking_or_covariance.note: same subjects biopsied pre and post; the paper does not state a paired design

matrix_scale: RSEM expected counts imported with tximport (counts, abundance, length) (S2.5.p1, S2.6.p1)
paper_method: tximport (gene level) -> DESeq2, BH-adjusted p (S2.6.p1); formula not reported

paper_threshold.effect_cutoff_original: log2FC > 1.5 / log2FC < -1.5 (written on the log2 scale)
paper_threshold.note: S2.6.p1: DESeq2, BH-adjusted p; S3.1.p1 applies |log2FC| > 1.5 and p-adj < .05 to every human cohort

reported_counts.top_genes: up in both: PPARGC1A, NR4A3, HSPA1B; NR4A1 up in hsAA (S3.1.p1)

enrichment.method: DAVID over-representation on all significantly up-regulated genes (|log2FC|>1.5, padj<.05); hsAS 204 GO terms, hsAA 149 terms; common: skeletal muscle cell differentiation, negative regulation of apoptotic process (S2.6.p3, S3.1.p1)
